count_pairs_product_in_array: count pairs in an array whose product also exists as an element in the array
run_f_gold: run f_gold to count pairs in an array where the product of each pair exists in the array
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple parameter sets to verify correct pair product counting results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash set instead of a linear scan for faster product lookup
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts pairs whose product exists in the given array using triple nested loops
